description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/weno5_D_inflow_bc. Every binding loads fixture.esm (N bound to 8 at the import edge), inlines the weno5_D_interior / weno5_recon / weno3_recon body-reference templates (esm-spec 9.7.3), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST: D(u,x) replaced by the rule's makearray (interior conservative WENO5-Z flux-difference aggregate (hatF_{i+1/2}-hatF_{i-1/2})/dx over [4,6]; the three inflow-wall faces i=1,2,3 carrying the free name gL in the upstream ghost slots and hatF_{1/2}=gL with the reduced-order WENO3 reconstruction; the two outflow-wall faces i=7,8 with the zeroth-order extrapolation ghost u[8] and WENO3), fired at priority 10, with zero apply_expression_template nodes, zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, zero surviving metaparameter names, and the free names dx and gL surviving. The expanded golden exceeds the 64 KiB checked-in threshold (the WENO5-Z reconstruction is repeated per face) so it is pinned by sha256 digest (expanded.golden.sha256) rather than stored, exactly like weno5_D_periodic. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
